items.title: Chinese-nexus actor’s Cairn AI agents found a zero-day on their own
items.summary: Amazon Threat Intelligence is sharing findings from an investigation into a Chinese-nexus threat actor using autonomous AI agents to conduct hacking operations with minimal human involvement. The actor gave the agents a simple goal: “obtain shell access.” During the campaign, the agents found a zero-day in an open-source application and used it to gain full […]
